title: Indian Cheese Paratha
description: A classic Indian flatbread filled with melted cheese, perfect for breakfast or snack. This recipe uses homemade paratha dough and a blend of cheese for an authentic taste.
instructions: 1. Start by making the paratha dough by combining 1 cup of flour, 1/4 cup of ghee or melted butter, and salt to taste. Knead for 5 minutes until smooth.
2. Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and roll out each portion into a thin circle.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook each paratha for 1-2 minutes on each side, until puffed and lightly browned.
4. Meanwhile, mix the mozzarella and cheddar cheese in a bowl.
5. Place a cooked paratha on a flat surface and spread a quarter of the cheese mixture on one half of the paratha.
6. Fold the other half over the cheese to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
7. Cook the paratha for another minute on each side, until the cheese is melted and the paratha is crispy.
8. Repeat with the remaining dough and cheese mixture.
9. Serve the Indian cheese paratha hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
